translations.web: You shall eat of it like the most holy things. Every male shall eat of it. It shall be holy to you.
translations.bsb: You are to eat it as a most holy offering, and every male may eat it. You shall regard it as holy.
translations.kjv: In the most holy place shalt thou eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy
translations.asv: As the most holy things shalt thou eat thereof; every male shall eat thereof: it shall be holy unto thee.
